title: Clinic operating hours
content: Standard clinic hours are Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday and Sunday are closed unless noted by a specific clinic.
description: General clinic hours guidance for appointment scheduling.

title: Symptom triage disclaimer
content: MediBook AI provides informational triage guidance only. It does not diagnose conditions or replace an in-person medical evaluation.
description: Standard triage disclaimer shown during symptom assessment.

title: PrimeCare appointment booking
content: PrimeCare Hospital appointments are typically 30 minutes. Please arrive 10 minutes early with your ID and any prior reports.
description: Clinic-specific booking guidance for PrimeCare Hospital.

title: City Health Clinic appointment booking
content: City Health Clinic accepts walk-ins until 4:30 PM on weekdays. Online bookings are recommended for faster check-in.
description: Clinic-specific booking guidance for City Health Clinic.
